title: veronica austriaca subsp. tenuifolia
intro: Veronica austriaca subsp. tenuifolia, commonly known as Austrian speedwell, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its calming effects, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Austrian speedwell are attributed to its ability to act as a nervine and sedative, which can help to soothe the nervous system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Austrian speedwell include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
